videos.title: Learn with Bibi: Wild Animals, Toys & More | 12 Min Learning Compilation for Kids | Bibi Buzz TV
videos.description:
12 minutes of learning with Bibi the bee and her friends! Wild Animals, Toys, Count 1 to 5, ABC Letters N to Z, and the fairy tale The Three Billy Goats Gruff.
Kids see every picture, hear the word, say it out loud and play fun quizzes. Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2-6).

Subscribe to Bibi Buzz TV: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfiz1ZdIyjFtTYkzFOUqqWQ?sub_confirmation=1

In this video: Hippo, Kangaroo, Crocodile, Penguin, Parrot, Deer; Ball, Teddy bear, Kite, Blocks, Balloon, Puzzle; 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; N is for Nose, O is for Orange, P is for Pizza, Q is for Queen, R is for Rainbow, S is for Sun, T is for Tree, U is for Umbrella, V is for Violin, W is for Whale, X is for X-ray, Y is for Yo-yo, Z is for Zebra.

videos.title: Baa Baa Rainbow Sheep | Learn Colors | Kids Song & Nursery Rhyme | Bibi Buzz TV
videos.description:
Sing along with Bibi, Pip, Mo and Lila! Baa baa rainbow sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, bags full of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple wool! Learn the colors of the rainbow and count the sacks of wool, with the words lighting up as we sing. A cheerful nursery rhyme for babies, toddlers and preschoolers.

Subscribe to Bibi Buzz TV: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfiz1ZdIyjFtTYkzFOUqqWQ?sub_confirmation=1

Lyrics:
Baa baa red sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, four bags full!

One for Bibi, one for Pip,
One for Mo and one for Lila!

Baa baa orange sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, four bags full!

One for Lila, one for Mo,
One for Pip and one for Bibi!

One for Pip and one for Lila!

Baa baa green sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, four bags full!

One for Lila, one for Pip,
One for Mo and one for Bibi!

Baa baa blue sheep, have you any wool?
Yes sir, yes sir, four bags full!

One for Pip, one for Bibi,
One for Lila and one for Mo!

Baa baa purple sheep, have you any wool?

videos.title: The Three Billy Goats Gruff | Fairy Tale Story for Kids | Bibi Buzz TV
videos.description:
Trip, trap! Trip, trap! Watch the classic fairy tale of The Three Billy Goats Gruff: three hungry brothers want to cross the old wooden bridge, to eat the sweet green grass on the other side, but a big, grumpy troll lives under it. A gentle, colorful animated story in simple English for toddlers and preschoolers.
